settings.text: Fast, free shipping and a hassle-free 30-day return policy — because your peace of mind matters.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders arrive within 6–11 business days, including 1–2 days of processing.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Yes — free standard shipping on all orders over $40. Orders under $40 have a flat rate calculated at checkout.

settings.question: Can I track my order?
settings.answer: Absolutely. You'll receive a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship to most countries. International shipping times and any duties are shown at checkout.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: You have 30 days from delivery to request a return for a full refund on unused items with tags.

settings.question: How do I start a return?
settings.answer: Email alonewolf1102@gmail.com with your order number. We'll send a prepaid label and instructions — you then have 14 days to post it back.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: Refunds are processed within 3–5 business days of us receiving your return, back to your original payment method.

settings.question: Can I exchange for a different size?
settings.answer: The fastest way is to return the original and place a new order for the size you'd like.

settings.heading: Need help with an order?
settings.text: Our team is here for you — email alonewolf1102@gmail.com and we'll reply within 24 hours.
